_doc: Plain-language standard data. Read by scripts/check_plain_language.mjs and linked from CLAUDE.md. Add terms here, never in CLAUDE.md. Each term's `match` is a regex source, matched case-insensitively with \b on both ends. `maxGrade` is what the hook blocks on; `targetGrade` is documentation only (and the second grade column of --report). `allow` entries are { file, path | key, term | rule } — `en.json` can only be allowed here, since JSON has no comments.
